class.name: GameplayAbilitySystem
class.brief_description: Data-driven per-character ability activation with costs, cooldowns, hierarchical tags and state persistence.
class.description: Create one GameplayAbilitySystem per character. Register ability definitions with [code]cost[/code] and [code]cooldown[/code] numbers (optional, default 0), and [code]required_tags[/code] and [code]blocked_tags[/code] PackedStringArray values (optional). Tag queries include nested tags: [code]status.stunned[/code] matches [code]status.stunned.heavy[/code]. Call [method tick] once per gameplay update to advance cooldowns. Abilities only manage activation policy: connect [signal ability_activated] in game code to execute animations, projectiles and other effects. Callers own networking authority, effect replication and animation. [method save_state] and [method load_state] serialize runtime resource, tags and cooldowns, not ability definitions. Re-register the same definitions before loading a state.

method.name: register_ability
method.description: Validate and deep-copy an ability definition. Invalid cost, cooldown, tags or ID leave existing registration untouched.

method.name: unregister_ability
method.description: Remove a definition and its active cooldown.

method.name: has_ability
method.description: Return whether an ability is registered.

method.name: get_ability
method.description: Return an independent copy of the definition, or an empty Dictionary.

method.name: get_activation_result
method.description: Check all conditions without changing state.

method.name: activate
method.description: On success, deduct the cost, start its cooldown, emit [signal ability_activated], and return ACTIVATED. On failure, emit [signal activation_failed] without consuming resources.

method.name: get_remaining_cooldown
method.description: Seconds of cooldown remaining, or zero.

method.name: tick
method.description: Advance cooldowns by a finite positive delta; zero, negative or non-finite values are ignored.

method.name: add_tag
method.description: Add a non-empty exact state tag. Returns false for duplicate or invalid tags.

method.name: remove_tag
method.description: Remove a tag by exact name.

method.name: has_tag
method.description: Match an exact tag or a descendant tag.

method.name: get_tags
method.description: Get a copy-on-write array of active tags.

method.name: set_max_resource
method.description: Set maximum resource, clamp current resource, emit resource_changed. Reject negative or non-finite values.

method.name: set_resource
method.description: Set current resource, clamped to maximum. Reject negative or non-finite values.

method.name: save_state
method.description: Return a versioned snapshot containing maximum resource, current resource, active tags and cooldowns.

method.name: load_state
method.description: Validate all snapshot fields and restore atomically; unknown cooldown ability IDs and invalid values are rejected without modifying any state.

signal.name: ability_activated
signal.description: Emitted when an activation succeeds. Game code applies the effect.

signal.name: cooldown_finished
signal.description: Emitted when a running cooldown reaches zero.

signal.name: resource_changed
signal.description: Emitted after resource or maximum changes.

signal.name: tags_changed
signal.description: Emitted when tags are added, removed or restored.

constants.constant: No ability with that ID is registered.
One or more required tags are absent.
One or more blocking tags are active.
